title: Rezoning to allow denser housing at 69-67 108th Street, Queens
summary: This application would change the zoning map for a site at 69-67 108th Street in Forest Hills, Queens from an R1-2A district to an R7D district, with a C2-4 commercial overlay. The change would allow denser residential and commercial development than currently permitted. The site is in Queens Community District 6 and Council District 29.
